# shopify_metaobject (List Resource)

Lists metaobject entries of one type, or of every type except app-owned ones (`app--…`). Reference values are GIDs of the listed store; replace them before applying generated config to another store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without config, every type except app-owned ones is listed.
list "shopify_metaobject" "materials" {
  provider = shopify
  config {
    type = "shopify--material"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Definition type to list, such as `shopify--material`. Unset lists every type except app-owned ones.
